summary.text: Mana Abdi is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 95, Androscoggin County, representing Lewiston.
The page lists committee service on Criminal Justice and Public Safety.

paragraphs.text: Mana Abdi lives in Lewiston and has served 2 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Bills in the Second Reading (member); Criminal Justice and Public Safety (member).
